title: Understanding the Pattern
text: The pattern `\w+:\s([**A-Za-z\s]+)` is designed to match sequences in the format of 'word: space non-alphabetic characters'.

title: Breaking Down the Pattern
text:
- `\w+` matches one or more word characters (letters, digits, or underscores).
- `:` matches the colon character.
- `\s` matches a single space.
- `([**A-Za-z\s]+)` captures one or more characters that are not letters or spaces.

title: Analyzing the Metadata
text: Look at the metadata string and identify parts that match the pattern. Focus on sections after a colon followed by a space, containing non-alphabetic characters.

title: Identifying Matches
text: List the matches found by the pattern in the order they appear in the metadata string.
